recipe.title: Carrot and butter bean soup with cumin
recipe.intro: Stored carrots grow sweeter through December, and blended with creamy butter beans they make a thick, warming lunch for the busy days before Christmas.
steps: Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry large saucepan over a medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, until they start to pop. Tip them into a bowl.
Add the oil, onion and garlic to the pan and cook for 5 minutes, stirring now and then, until the onion is soft.
Stir in the carrots and cumin and cook for 2 minutes, until the spice smells toasty.
Add the butter beans and stock with a good pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the carrots are soft enough to squash with a spoon.
Take off the heat and blend with a stick blender until smooth. Add a splash of water if it is too thick.
Stir in the lemon juice, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into bowls and top with a spoonful of yoghurt and the toasted seeds.
recipe.tip: Keeps for 3 days in the fridge or 3 months in the freezer. Freeze it before adding the yoghurt and seeds.
